parsed.rationale: All five members are type-alias-objects with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural pipeline detected shape similarity solely on the basis of them being empty type aliases — not on shared field content. The aliases serve distinct domain roles: `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` are Discogs API response model aliases in `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift`, while `Release` and `Artist` in `Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift` and `_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift` are Metadata-layer repository aliases. The `_Plant_` prefix on the Metadata files further signals these are scaffolded/planted stubs with intentionally minimal bodies, making the empty-body match purely coincidental. Consolidating these across the `Artwork` and `Metadata` package boundary would couple unrelated domain layers without any real deduplication benefit.
